use_case_name: Exchange IFF and SIF Transponder Data

evidence_cards.content: IFF/SIF data (Modes I, II, and III Codes) are transmitted in the J3.1 and J3.5 (PTI = 0) messages when available.

source_locations.location: paragraph under section 4.4.3.5 REPORTING TRANSPONDER DATA ON POINTS

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This directly states the objective of exchanging IFF/SIF transponder data via specific message types, which is the core goal of the use case for the C2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: The exchange of IFF/SIF modes and codes consists of five functional areas: IFF/SIF Surveillance Data Reporting, Unique Mode II Code Protection, Clearing IFF/SIF Data, IFF/SIF Difference Resolution, and IFF/SIF Update Request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the high-level objective (goal) of the use case as the exchange of IFF/SIF data through specific functional areas.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.5 (ACT = 2) message is used to exchange codes that have special meaning for implementing JUs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This statement explicitly defines the high-level objective of the use case involving the J7.5 message and IFF/SIF data exchange.

evidence_cards.content: IFF/SIF data (Modes I, II, and III Codes) must be available to the system.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: The text states that IFF/SIF data is transmitted in J3.1 and J3.5 messages 'when available', implying availability is a prerequisite for transmission.

evidence_cards.content: The reporting of IFF/SIF surveillance data in the J3.2C1 and J3.3C1 words for Air and Surface tracks is the responsibility of the JU with R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state regarding role assignment (R² unit) which determines who initiates standard surveillance data reporting.

evidence_cards.content: All other JUs without R² are responsible for monitoring such data and only reporting if they hold different data with the J7.5 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the condition under which non-R² units participate in the exchange (holding different data).

evidence_cards.content: Validity of codes for established tracks will be determined as either 'Valid Data' or 'No Data'.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies that track validity status must be determined before reporting rules apply.

evidence_cards.content: For the J7.5 (ACT = 2) Update Request function, the initiating unit (R² or nonR²) must have the applicable mode indicators set.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a required system state (mode indicators set) before the update request interaction can be initiated.

evidence_cards.content: For the J7.5 (ACT = 3) Special Code Reporting function, the JU must implement the special code capability.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits IFF/SIF data (Modes I, II, and III Codes) in J3.1 and J3.5 (PTI = 0) messages when available.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the triggering condition for exchanging IFF/SIF transponder data: availability of the data prompts transmission via designated message types.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.5 message with action values ACT = 0 (Clear), ACT = 1 (Difference Report), ACT = 2 (Update Request), or ACT = 3 (Special Code) is used to perform IFF/SIF data management and reporting functions.

evidence_cards.content: Reporting of IFF/SIF data in conjunction with periodic surveillance data is the responsibility of the JU with R²; all other JUs without R² are responsible only for monitoring such data and reporting different data via the J7.5 message.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a conditional trigger context: whether the C2 JU holds R² determines if it initiates routine reporting or only reports differences — thus constraining when and how the use case is triggered.

evidence_cards.content: Data updating can occur spontaneously as a result of the R² unit reporting a No Data status (value 0) for one or more modes in a required IFF/SIF Surveillance data report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific system-generated event (No Data status report) that acts as a trigger for the data exchange/update process.

evidence_cards.content: Data updating can also occur as a result of an operator action wherein the update request is transmitted in a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific user action (transmitting a J7.5 ACT=2 message) that triggers the update request function.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.5 IFF/SIF Management function includes an Update Request message (ACT = 2), a Special Code message (ACT = 3), and a Difference Report message (ACT = 1).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific management messages available for the main flow of exchanging IFF/SIF data.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.6 Filter Management function includes a Filter Implementation Request message (ACT = 0), a Filter Description Report message (ACT = 1), and a Delete Filter Request/Report message (ACT = 2).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies filter management actions that may be part of the interaction sequence for configuring surveillance data exchange.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.7 Association function includes an Associate Data message (ACT = 0) and a Terminate Association message (ACT = 1).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies association setup and teardown actions that are steps in the normal interaction sequence.

evidence_cards.content: IFF/SIF data (Modes I, II, and III Codes) are transmitted in the J3.1 and J3.5 (PTI = 0) messages when available.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the primary action of the main flow: transmitting surveillance data using specific message types when the data is ready.

evidence_cards.content: The IFF/SIF data in the J3.1 message shall contain the IFF/SIF modes and codes of the previously reported track for which the emergency point was initiated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a constraint on the content of the transmission within the main flow, linking the IFF/SIF data to the context of an emergency point report.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with R² transmits IFF/SIF surveillance data (Modes I, II, and III codes) periodically in J3.1/J3.5 messages to report valid data held for a track.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.5 message with action value ACT = 2 is used to transmit an IFF/SIF Update Request message.

evidence_cards.content: Reporting of IFF/SIF data in conjunction with periodic surveillance data is the responsibility of the JU with R², while all other JUs without R² are responsible for monitoring such data and only reporting different data with the J7.5 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the conditional logic for which actor performs the reporting step in the main flow based on role (R² vs non-R²).

evidence_cards.content: For the 'Clearing IFF/SIF Data' function: The operator may originate a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message to clear one or more modes on a specified track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the initiation step for clearing data within the exchange use case.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of the J7.5 (ACT = 0) message, all JUs automatically set the designated mode(s) for the specified track to the No Data status.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system's automatic response and state change upon receiving the clear command.

evidence_cards.content: If accepted, the No Data status is used for all subsequent interface functions and data link messages until updated by valid code responses from local or remote sources.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the duration and scope of the effect resulting from the main flow action.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R², upon receiving or initiating a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message that results in no IFF/SIF data being held on the track, shall not continue transmitting the periodic J3 message that includes the continuation word containing IFF/SIF data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a specific behavior constraint (stopping transmission) triggered by the completion of the clear action.

evidence_cards.content: Any JU may change a local mode to a No Data status without transmitting a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies an alternative path to achieve the 'No Data' status that bypasses the standard exchange protocol.

evidence_cards.content: For IFF/SIF Update Requests (J7.5 ACT=2), R² units receiving the message will respond by initiating a J3.XC1 message regardless of the No Data status.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the mandatory response action for R² units in the main flow of an update request interaction.

evidence_cards.content: NonR² units receiving the J7.5 (ACT = 2) message from the R² unit will respond by initiating a J7.5 (ACT = 1) message if valid local data (nonzero codes) are held for the requested mode(s).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the conditional response action for NonR² units in the main flow of an update request interaction.

evidence_cards.content: The JU originating or changing a special code shall assume J7.5 (ACT = 3) reporting responsibility for retransmission until such time as a special code message is received for that track from another unit, or the track is dropped, or a clear special code is received.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the continuous reporting obligation for the primary actor during the exchange of special codes.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU transmits a J7.5 (ACT = 3) Special Code message all nonzero special codes for that track will be reported.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the content requirement for the transmission step in the special code exchange flow.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU may transmit an IFF/SIF Update Request message (J7.5 with ACT = 2) to request updated transponder data from another unit.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU may transmit a Special Code message (J7.5 with ACT = 3) to exchange special-meaning IFF/SIF codes.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU may send a Filter Implementation Request (J7.6 with ACT = 0), receive a Filter Description Report (J7.6 with ACT = 1), or send/receive a Delete Filter Request/Report (J7.6 with ACT = 2).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These represent alternative flows for managing filtering rules applied to IFF/SIF data exchange — valid success paths that modify how data is processed or reported, diverging from standard surveillance reporting.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU may initiate an Associate Data message (J7.7 with ACT = 0) or Terminate Association message (J7.7 with ACT = 1) to manage logical associations between tracks or entities.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: These are alternative successful interactions that manage contextual relationships during IFF/SIF data exchange, representing divergence points from the core periodic reporting main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits IFF/SIF data in a J7.5 (ACT = 1) Difference Report to report a difference in accordance with the Difference Resolution Matrix, which may be initiated by operator action anytime.

evidence_cards.content: When an R² JU changes the Environment/Category of a surveillance entity as a result of operator initiative or acceptance of a J7.0 (ACT=1) Difference Report or (ACT=2) Change Data Order, the decision to retain the original TN or report the entity with a new TN shall follow paragraph 4.4.2.8 and Table 4.7-1.

evidence_cards.content: If the R² JU identifies an ID conflict, the operator is alerted and local ID data continues to be reported in the surveillance message with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 1; the conflict is resolved by manual means.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific alternative path for handling ID conflicts where reporting continues despite the conflict, diverging from standard conflict resolution logic.

evidence_cards.content: For NonR² JUs, if a conflict is indicated, the unit shall inhibit transmission of the J7.0 (ACT = 1) until the surveillance message is received with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a conditional alternative flow where transmission is inhibited based on the state of the Identity Difference Indicator.

evidence_cards.content: NonR² JUs may alternatively take no action with respect to the reported ID when a conflict is indicated, though an operator alert may be provided as a system option.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a valid optional alternative flow where the system ignores the conflict rather than inhibiting transmission.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if local/remote data held indicates that the two tracks have an Identity (ID) difference which constitutes a conflict.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if they have different Mode II codes and the local Mode II code is current.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies another restriction where the system inhibits automatic correlation based on Mode II code discrepancies, serving as an alternative flow to prevent merging incompatible tracks.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs shall not automatically correlate two tracks if both tracks are locally derived real-time tracks being updated with local positional data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a constraint preventing the correlation of redundant local tracks, defining an alternative behavior when dual local sources exist.

evidence_cards.content: For Land (Ground) tracks, when the J3.5C3 word is not implemented, then only the J3.5I word Strength field is transmitted or received.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific alternative flow for the exchange of strength data where a capability (J3.5C3 implementation) is missing, causing the process to diverge from the standard transmission of both J3.5C3 and J3.5I fields to transmitting/receiving only the J3.5I field.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits a J7.5 (ACT = 0) Clear IFF/SIF message to clear data when initiated by operator action.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow for clearing IFF/SIF data, diverging from the standard periodic reporting.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits a J7.5 (ACT = 1) Difference Report to report changes in locally entered data (e.g., zero to nonzero) or in response to a 'No Data' report on one or more modes/codes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow for difference resolution and reporting specific data state changes.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU transmits a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request when initiated by operator action.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where the C2 JU requests an update of IFF/SIF data rather than just reporting it.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU shall have an operator selectable capability to deactivate automatic transmission of the J7.2 correlation message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a legal alternative path where the operator manually overrides the automatic flow defined in step 4.7.3.1.a (initiating transmission upon dual designation), allowing the system to proceed without sending the message.

evidence_cards.content: If the originating C2 JU holds R² for the Dropped TN, it shall drop the Dropped TN and transmit the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message after the J7.2 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an additional action required within the successful alternative flow when the specific condition of holding R² responsibility exists, diverging from the standard exchange by adding a termination message.

evidence_cards.content: The J7.5 (ACT = 0) Clear IFF/SIF message designating all modes or Mode II code of the specified track to be cleared shall cause the Mode II code status to be returned to a No Data status.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines an alternative flow where the exchange results in clearing data and returning to a No Data status rather than updating with new codes.

evidence_cards.content: Any JU may originate, by operator action only, the J7.5 (ACT = 0) message for the clearing of one or more modes on the specified track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the trigger condition (operator action) for the alternative flow of clearing specific modes.

evidence_cards.content: All JUs, upon receipt of the J7.5 (ACT = 0) message, shall automatically set the designated mode(s) for the specified track to the No Data status.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the system response and state change for receiving units in this alternative flow.

evidence_cards.content: An alternative flow occurs when the R² unit reports a No Data status (value 0) for one or more modes in a required J3.XC1 surveillance data report; receiving units holding valid nonzero data respond as required by the IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a spontaneous data update path that diverges from the main periodic reporting flow, triggered by a No Data condition rather than scheduled transmission.

evidence_cards.content: Another alternative flow is initiated manually by an operator transmitting a J7.5 (ACT = 2) IFF/SIF Update Request message; receiving units respond by transmitting their local data codes.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This represents a manual intervention path that diverges from the automatic periodic reporting, allowing on-demand data refresh via explicit request.

evidence_cards.content: When a C2 JU (specifically the R² unit) transmits a J3.XC1 message with a 'NO DATA' report (value 0) for one or more modes while local nonzero IFF/SIF is held, it triggers a difference resolution response from other units.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific condition ('No Data' report on active track) that deviates from standard periodic reporting and acts as an exception trigger requiring a system response (Difference Resolution).

evidence_cards.content: The transmission of a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report may be initiated by operator action anytime to resolve discrepancies, representing an intervention outside the standard automated flow.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception handling path where an operator manually intervenes to correct data differences, diverging from the automatic surveillance reporting cycle.

evidence_cards.content: If an R² shift occurs during execution of a Data Update Request (DUR) response where the Number/Frequency of Updates field is set to value 2 or 3, the JU assuming R² shall not respond to any prior Data Update Request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow where a role transfer (R² shift) interrupts an ongoing data exchange process, resulting in the cancellation of pending responses.

evidence_cards.content: If a selection conflict occurs due to OCCs on both the Retained TN and the Dropped TN during dual designation determination, the correlation shall be abandoned until the next correlation check.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception path where automatic correlation is halted due to conflicting data conditions (OCCs) on both tracks.

evidence_cards.content: C2 JUs receiving a J7.2 message with the RV field set to value 0 or 1 shall not accept the requested correlation when local or remote data held indicates one or more of the following conditions exist: (1) There is a correlation restriction as listed in paragraph 4.4.4.3.1g; In this case the correlation shall be rejected.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies an exception condition for the receiving actor where valid correlation requests are explicitly rejected based on existing restrictions.

evidence_cards.content: When local sensors detect a Mode II code change, the system shall treat it as a new track.

evidence_cards.content: Paragraph 5.7.1 describes the requirement for initial transmission and explains the way message redundancy is specified; each message contains the special rules required for the transmission and reception of that message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that specific error-handling or exception rules (e.g., redundancy, transmission/reception constraints) are defined per-message in paragraph 5.7.1 — indicating where exception_flow behavior may be documented, though not detailed on this page.

evidence_cards.content: The general rules and conventions common to the entire Surveillance function are defined in paragraph 4.4.2; subsequent paragraphs describe rules for reporting Point, Air, Surface, Land, Subsurface, Space, Ballistic Missile, and EW surveillance data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Indicates that exception handling for surveillance data reporting (including IFF/SIF) is governed by generalized conventions in 4.4.2 and specialized rules in 4.4.3–4.4.7 — suggesting exception_flow logic is distributed across these sections, but no concrete exception triggers or responses are provided on this page.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU without R² desires that a specific point, line, or area be transmitted immediately without awaiting the next periodic update, it should transmit a J7.1 (ACT = 1) Data Update Request for the desired TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an exception handling path where a non-reporting unit initiates a data request to bypass normal periodic update timing, which constitutes an alternative flow triggered by urgency rather than standard reporting cycles.

evidence_cards.content: Any JU may report, through operator action only, on a previously reported emergency point when that JU has additional or more current information on the point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception condition where a non-R² unit can assume reporting responsibility under specific conditions (additional info, inactive R², or missed updates), representing an alternative success path outside normal R² assignment.

evidence_cards.content: In addition, if a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received on an emergency point, the unit with R² is declared inactive, or if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another JU may, by operator action only, assume R² for the point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines explicit failure conditions (R² inactivity declaration or three missed updates) that trigger an exception flow allowing transfer of reporting responsibility to another unit.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU ceases reporting a point, line, or area for which it had reporting responsibility, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the termination procedure when a JU stops reporting, which represents an exception flow ending the normal reporting cycle and transferring responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: For the J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report function, a receiving unit may report a difference in accordance with Table 4.7-5 IFF/SIF Difference Resolution Matrix when locally entered data changes from zero to nonzero or nonzero to another nonzero value, or in response to a J3.XC1 'NO DATA' report on one or more mode/code when local nonzero IFF/SIF is held.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an exception flow where a receiving unit detects a discrepancy or 'No Data' status and must initiate a corrective difference report, diverging from normal monitoring.

evidence_cards.content: The transmission of a J7.5 (ACT=1) Difference Report may be initiated by operator action anytime, serving as an exception path for manual resolution of data discrepancies.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies an operator-initiated exception handling path for resolving differences outside of automatic triggers.

evidence_cards.content: If the R² JU identifies that an ID conflict exists, the operator shall be alerted and the local ID data shall continue to be reported in the appropriate surveillance message, with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 1; the conflict will be resolved by manual means.

evidence_cards.content: For NonR² JUs, if a conflict is indicated, the unit shall inhibit transmission of the J7.0 (ACT = 1) until the surveillance message is received with the Identity Difference Indicator set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception handling behavior for NonR² units: suppresses ACT=1 transmission upon conflict indication until indicator resets to 0 — a conditional inhibition as part of error containment.

evidence_cards.content: Alternatively, NonR² JUs may take no action with respect to the reported ID; an operator alert may be provided as a system option.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides an optional exception response for NonR² units: passive handling with possible operator alert — represents a configurable exception tolerance path rather than active intervention.

evidence_cards.content: If an R² shift occurs during execution of a Data Update Request (DUR) response where the Number/Frequency of Updates field is set to value 2 or 3, the JU assuming R² shall not respond to any prior Data Update Request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow condition (R² shift) that prevents the completion of the data exchange initiated by a previous request.

evidence_cards.content: When an operator receives an IFF/SIF data conflict alert (as required in Table 4.7-5), he shall have the following manual actions at his disposal for attempting resolution of the difference: (1) Update local data manually or verify automatic inputs; (2) Initiate J7.5 (ACT = 0) Clear IFF/SIF message (any mode); (3) Initiate J7.5 (ACT = 1) IFF/SIF Difference Report message (any mode); (4) Change local data to agree with remote data except in the case of Mode II code; (5) Decorrelate the local data from the remote data, causing the assignment of a new track number to local data; (6) Clear operator alert (any mode).

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of any J7.5 message action value (Clear, Difference Report, Update Request, or Special Code), the IFF/SIF data state between Interface Units (IUs) is updated to ensure commonality of data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the immediate system state change (data commonality) resulting from the use case actions.

evidence_cards.content: The latest Link 11/11B, NATO Link 1 TN, ATDL-1 TN, or IJMS SRN received on a track supersedes previously received data.

source_locations.location: Last sentence of the second paragraph

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the final data state rule regarding Track Number identifiers after the exchange process.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² that initiates a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message resulting in no IFF/SIF data being held on the track shall not continue transmitting the periodic J3 message that includes the continuation word containing IFF/SIF data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the postcondition state for the primary actor (JU with R²) after successfully executing the Clear action described in the alternative flow: transmission of the specific data field ceases.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt and acceptance of a J7.5 (ACT = 0) message, all JUs automatically set the designated mode(s) for the specified track to the No Data status.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the postcondition state for receiving units after the Clear message is processed: the internal status of the modes is updated to 'No Data'.
